text:
alice: Heads-up — slicebench KV retention run finished, leaving a persistent plateau around ~1.2GB RSS after ~600k tokens. Not normal.
ben: Can you drop the artifact link + raw logs?
carmen: saw a few anomalies in the CI summary yesterday but not sure if they're the same.
alice: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/1729991234 (kv-slicebench/retention/*). Key excerpt below from the run that reproduced locally:
```
[run] token=600000 total_rss=1224MB cached_extents=1824 evicted=423 restored=419
[run] token=700000 total_rss=1228MB cached_extents=1830 evicted=435 restored=433
# growth stops, but fragmentation ratio increases: free_extents=27 -> 11
```
ben: Hmm. evicted ~= restored -> churn, but RSS still not decreasing (fragmentation?). Did you run with thin slices (<64)?
alice: repro script I used:
```
./tools/kvbench --slices=32 --long-context --tokens=1000000 --seed=42 --profile=flame
```
perf-bot: Automated test "kv-slice-retention-ci" finished: PASS but rss-drift=+120MB over baseline (warn), latency OK, throughput OK. (job: #2147)

carmen: I think this is different from the usual spill/paging: the allocator keeps small free chunks between cached blocks so usable free memory drops. Suspect allocation alignment for KV pages at slice boundaries.
dmitri: @alice can you share the flame graph? If the hot path is in cache restore/merge we might be continually splitting extents. link? 
alice: flame at https://perf.redwood/flames/1729991234.svg — top hotspots: kv::restore_extent, kv::split_extent, kv::slab_alloc
ben: quick hypothesis: when slice_size < 64 we hit an internal path that rounds up then splits causing fragmentation. I saw similar in older heap-tuning notes. Proposed quick patch: coalesce-on-restore and increase min_extent_size to 256 for small-slice runs.
carmen: Can we gate this as a regression in CI? Suggest rule: if rss_growth > 50MB after 100k tokens (sustained for 3 samples) -> fail. Also add a synthetic long-context test with slices 16/32/64.
dmitri: I'll open a PR to add both the regression test and an allocator counter to expose fragmentation ratio. PR -> #3421. I'll also add a microbench to assert eviction/restores stay within 2% of each other on steady-state workloads.

alice: Thanks — can someone add a short note in the release checklist to run the slicebench on dedicated capacity? I want cross-hardware repro (A100 vs T4) before merging coalesce change.
ben: ack. I'll run on T4 in my dev org and paste results.

carmen: one more: please log the full extent map snapshot in debug mode when free_extents<20 (small dump) so we can replay in the fuzz harness.
alice: Will do. Adding to the task: reproduce -> add snapshot hook -> add CI guard -> try coalesce patch -> perf run.
dmitri: assigning self to PR + tests. ping me if you want pair debugging later today. :wave:
ben: thanks, all. :thumbsup:
